Hadhrat Ummu Habeebah (RA) Forgives Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) at the Time of her death

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "Ummu Habeebah the wife of Rasulullaah ﷺ called for me as she lay on her deathbed. She said, 'There had been incidents between us as occurs between co-wives. May Allaah forgive me and you for all such incidents that occurred between us.' I replied by saying, 'May Allaah forgive you all of that, overlook it and save you from the punishment of it all.' She then said, 'You have made me happy. May Allaah keep you happy.' She then sent for Ummu Salamah and said the same to her." [^2]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Goes to Hadhrat Faatima (RA) to Make her Happy

Hadhrat Sha'bi narrates that when Hadhrat Faatima (RA) fell ill (just before her demise), Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) went to request permission to address her. (Her husband) Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "O Faatima! Abu Bakr (RA) wants permission to speak to you." "Do you want me to permit him?" she asked. When Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied in the affirmative, she granted permission. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then started saying things that would please her. He said, "By Allaah! I forsook my home, wealth, family and tribe only for the pleasure of Allaah, for the pleasure of His Rasool ﷺ and for your pleasure, the household of Rasulullaah ﷺ." He then continued saying things to make her happy until she was pleased. [^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) asks Forgiveness from a Man whom he Disliked

Hadhrat Sha'bi narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once mentioned that he disliked a particular person. People then started asking him why Hadhrat Umar (RA) so disliked him. Eventually, when too many people came to his house, he approached Hadhrat Umar (RA) and asked, "O Umar! Have I caused a rift in Islaam (amongst the Muslims)?"
